title: Accelerate-Stop Distance
conditions: Wing flaps retracted, full throttle and max RPM, both throttles closed at decision speed, accelerate to 90 MPH IAS, maximum braking effort, paved/level/dry runway

exampleCheck.note: Worked example printed on the chart (points A-F). Re-measured directly from reference/fig5-08-accelerate-stop.png pixel positions on 2026-10-01. Two rounds of correction: first pass fixed the 6000 ft altitude curve's slope (was off ~9x) but kept the ORIGINAL example's input conditions (pa/oatF/weightLb/windMph) unverified, assuming 65F/3100lb/10mph by analogy with other charts. A second pass found those assumed inputs were also wrong -- the dashed temperature line actually sits at 70F (not 65), point C sits at weight=3200 (not 3100), and point F sits at wind=30mph headwind (not 10) -- confirmed by directly overlaying calibrated axis gridlines on zoomed crops of each dashed-line crossing. The measured B/D/F height values (2800/2450/2050 ft) were unaffected by this relabeling (they're read from pixel ROW, independent of which column/axis-label was assumed), but weightExponent and windKPerMph were recomputed against the correct weight/wind magnitudes.

unverifiedAltitudes.note: The 0/2000/4000/8000 ft altitudeCurves entries below are the ORIGINAL, unverified digitization. Only the 6000 ft entry (above) and the weight/wind exponents have been independently re-measured pixel-by-pixel against the source chart. Given the 6000 ft entry was off by ~9x, these others may carry similar error and should be re-checked before being trusted for altitudes other than 6000 ft.
